'''Explosive tipped arrows''' were a special type of explosive [[Arrow/Legends|arrow]] that could be fired with a [[Corellian compound bow]].<ref name="Suns of Fortune" /> After [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]<ref name="EotE date">The [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] establishes that ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' takes place after the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], an event that occurred during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], dated by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], explosive tipped arrows could be bought for 50 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Suns of Fortune" />

==Behind the scenes==
Explosive tipped arrows arrows were mentioned in ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'', ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]].<ref name="Suns of Fortune" />
